summary: Uncover the key functions of a Lead Cloud Security Manager, focusing on risk management, compliance, and the implementation of effective security measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are responsible for securing cloud environments and managing cloud-based information assets. This course is designed for: Cloud Security Managers overseeing the implementation of ISO/IEC 27017 controls. Information Security Professionals developing cloud security policies and procedures. IT Risk Managers assessing and mitigating cloud computing security risks. Compliance Officers ensuring adherence to ISO/IEC 27018 for PII protection. Cloud Architects designing secure cloud infrastructure and services. Security Consultants advising organizations on cloud security best practices. Data Protection Officers managing data privacy in public cloud environments. DevOps Security Engineers integrating security into cloud development pipelines. Cloud Operations Managers responsible for secure cloud service delivery. Auditors evaluating cloud security program effectiveness against ISO standards.
modules: Initiating a Cloud Security Program with ISO/IEC 27017 and 27018
Cloud Risk Management and ISO/IEC 27017 Controls
Documented Information and Cloud Security Awareness
Incident Response, Testing, and Continual Cloud Security
PECB Lead Cloud Security Manager Certification Exam
prerequisites: To participate in this training course, you should have a fundamental understanding of ISO/IEC 27017 and ISO/IEC 27018. Additionally, a general knowledge of cloud computing concepts is recommended to maximize your learning experience.
